liveCaptureNotes: Use a well-lit place with a plain background
Keep the camera at eye level before taking the photo
Stand directly in front of the camera and look straight ahead
Ensure your entire face is within the prescribed capture area
Do not wear a cap, mask, or spectacles/glasses
If webcam capture is unavailable, use the official SSC mobile app via the QR code provided in the application portal

name: RRB Group D
fullName: Railway Recruitment Board Level 1 Posts (Group D)

notes: Signature must be written by the candidate only
Sign using a black ink pen on white paper
Signature must be in running handwriting (cursive/joined letters)
Do not use BLOCK, CAPITAL, or disjoined letters
Signature must be clear, legible, and fully visible
Image file must be in JPG/JPEG format
Minimum image dimensions: 140 px × 60 px
Center the signature within the 35 mm × 20 mm scan box

liveCaptureNotes: Candidates are not required to upload a pre-existing photograph
Capture the live photo using a webcam or the front camera of a mobile phone
Wear non-white clothing, preferably dark colours, for good contrast
Use a well-lit place with a plain background
Keep the camera at eye level before capturing the photograph
Stand directly in front of the camera and look straight ahead with a neutral expression
Ensure the entire face is clearly visible and centered within the frame
Do not stand too close to or too far from the camera
Do not wear a cap, mask, or spectacles/glasses
Do not capture or upload a photograph of a printed or digital photograph
Retake the photo if necessary before final submission
Applications with non-compliant photographs are liable to be rejected
